refactor(camellia): migrate question content editor to edubox

The question-content.tsx component (~7400 lines) has been extracted into
the @edubox/question-content-editor package in the edubox repository.

Changes:
- Add @edubox/question-content-editor dependency in camellia/package.json
  (pointing to feat/editor-package branch until merged to main)
- Update education-pages.tsx to import from @edubox/question-content-editor
  instead of the local @/components/question-content

The original question-content.tsx can be removed once this branch is
confirmed working. It is kept here for now to avoid breaking the build
until the edubox PR is merged and the dependency resolves correctly.
